rows.question: What is the current building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of the history department?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  TRIM(
    CONCAT(
      COALESCE(fba.STREET_NUMBER, ''),
      CASE WHEN fba.STREET_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
      COALESCE(fba.STREET_NAME, '')
    )
  ) AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  fba.CITY AS CITY,
  fba.STATE AS STATE,
  fba.POSTAL_CODE AS POSTAL_CODE
FROM master_dept_hierarchy mdh
JOIN fclt_organization fo
  ON mdh.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY
JOIN fclt_building fb
  ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fb.COST_CENTER_CODE
LEFT JOIN fclt_building_address fba
  ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
WHERE LOWER(mdh.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History')
  AND fo.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE IS NOT NULL
  AND fb.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE IS NOT NULL
  -- ensure the address row is current (if present)
  AND (fba.FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY IS NULL OR fba.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE IS NOT NULL)
LIMIT 1

rows.question: Show the unique activity titles, locations, term start date, and supervisor name for all independent activities, sorted by the ascending order of start date.

WITH leader_assignments AS (
  SELECT
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AS activity_id,
    d.ACTIVITY_TITLE,
    s.SESSION_LOCATION,
    d.CREATE_DATE AS term_start_date,
    p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY AS person_id,
    p.PERSON_NAME
  FROM iap_subject_detail d
  JOIN iap_subject_person p
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
  JOIN iap_subject_session s
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  WHERE p.PERSON_ROLE = 'Activity leader'
    -- activity must be independent: interpret IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION = 'false' or = '0' or = 'N' or = 'No' means independent.
    -- Include common truthy/falsey stored values; adjust if your data uses a different sentinel.
    AND (
      d.IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION IS NULL
      OR LOWER(TRIM(d.IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION)) IN ('false','0','n','no')
      OR d.IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION = ''
    )
)
SELECT
  ACTIVITY_TITLE AS activity_title,
  SESSION_LOCATION AS location,
  term_start_date,
  PERSON_NAME AS supervisor_name
FROM leader_assignments
GROUP BY
  ACTIVITY_TITLE,
  SESSION_LOCATION,
  term_start_date,
  PERSON_NAME
ORDER BY term_start_date ASC

rows.question: What is the room, floor, building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of Professor Summer Haynes's office?

  SELECT
    z.SPACE_UNIT_CODE AS space_unit_code,
    z.BUILDING_ROOM AS room,
    z.FLOOR AS floor,
    z.BUILDING_COMPONENT AS building_key,
    NULL AS person_mit_id
  FROM zpm_rooms_load z
  WHERE z.SPACE_USAGE = 'Office'
    AND z.SPACE_UNIT_CODE IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  lo.room AS room,
  lo.floor AS floor,
  lo.building_key AS building_key,
  CONCAT_WS(' ',
    fba.STREET_NUMBER,
    fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL,
    fba.STREET_NAME,
    fba.STREET_SUFFIX,
    fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL
  ) AS building_street_address,
  fba.CITY AS city,
  fba.STATE AS state,
  fba.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code
FROM locations_offices lo
-- join the person to their office via OFFICE_LOCATION on se_person
JOIN se_person p
  ON p.FULL_NAME = 'Haynes, Summer'
-- match the person's OFFICE_LOCATION to the building (BUILDING_KEY) in fac_building_address
JOIN fac_building_address fba
  ON fba.BUILDING_KEY = lo.building_key
  AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
-- ensure we only return the office tied to the person's OFFICE_LOCATION (if ROOM/BUILDING linkage differs,
-- this keeps the building linked from zpm_rooms_load but filters by the person's office location if available)
WHERE p.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
  AND (p.OFFICE_LOCATION = lo.space_unit_code OR p.OFFICE_LOCATION = lo.building_key)
ORDER BY fba.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT
  COALESCE(fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME, fcr.ROOM_FULL_NAME) AS room_full_name,
  COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbl.BUILDING_NAME) AS building_name,
  COALESCE(
    CONCAT_WS(' ',
      NULLIF(fba.STREET_NUMBER,''), NULLIF(fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL,''), NULLIF(fba.STREET_NAME,''), NULLIF(fba.STREET_SUFFIX,''), NULLIF(fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL,'')),
    CONCAT_WS(' ',

  ) AS street_address,

  COALESCE(fba.STATE, facba.STATE) AS state,
  COALESCE(fba.POSTAL_CODE, facba.POSTAL_CODE) AS postal_code,
  COALESCE(fbl.BUILDING_HEIGHT, fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT) AS building_height
FROM subject_enrollable se
-- join to subject_offered to find meeting places for enrollable subjects
JOIN subject_offered so
  ON (so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = se.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID)
     OR (so.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.SUBJECT_ID = se.ULT_MASTER_SUBJECT_ID)
     OR (so.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.SUBJECT_ID = se.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID)
     OR (so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = se.ULT_MASTER_SUBJECT_ID)
-- only consider Computer Science (Electrical Eng & Computer Sci) subjects:
-- subject_enrollable does not have DEPARTMENT_NAME; match by OFFER_DEPT_CODE via lookup tables where available
LEFT JOIN subject_selector ss ON ss.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = se.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID OR ss.ULT_MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = se.ULT_MASTER_SUBJECT_ID OR ss.SUBJECT_ID = se.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_department dmap ON dmap.SUBJECT_CODE = ss.SUBJECT_OR_CLUSTER OR dmap.SUBJECT_CODE = se.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_department dmap2 ON dmap2.SUBJECT_CODE = se.ULT_MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
-- room sources
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms fr ON fr.SPACE_ID = so.MEET_PLACE OR fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY = so.MEET_PLACE
LEFT JOIN fclt_rooms fcr ON fcr.SPACE_ID = so.MEET_PLACE OR fcr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = so.MEET_PLACE OR fcr.BUILDING_ROOM = so.MEET_PLACE
-- building sources (try to resolve from room -> building key/number)
LEFT JOIN buildings b ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY OR b.BUILDING_NUMBER = fcr.BUILDING_ROOM
LEFT JOIN fac_building fb ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY OR fb.BUILDING_NUMBER = fcr.BUILDING_ROOM
LEFT JOIN fclt_building fbl ON fbl.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fcr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY OR fbl.BUILDING_NUMBER = fr.BUILDING_KEY
-- street addresses (prefer fac_building_address for fac_rooms, fclt_building_address for fclt_rooms)
LEFT JOIN fac_building_address fba ON fba.BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
LEFT JOIN fclt_building_address facba ON facba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fcr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND facba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
WHERE
  -- require enrollable subject to be associated with Computer Science department name
  (
    ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
    OR dmap.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM subject_selector s2 WHERE s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmap.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    )
    OR dmap2.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM subject_selector s3 WHERE s3.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND s3.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmap2.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    )
    OR se.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
    OR se.ULT_MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
  )
  -- ensure we have a meet place mapping to a room/building (so rows represent actual rooms)
  AND (fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY IS NOT NULL OR fcr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY IS NOT NULL)

rows.question: List the unique term code, subject title, room, floor, building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code, formats, and number of enrolled students for all courses with more than 300 attendees.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subject_titles AS (
  SELECT
    ss.TERM_CODE,
    ss.SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, se.SUBJECT_TITLE, dcc.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_title
  FROM `subject_summary` ss
  LEFT JOIN `subject_offered_summary` sos
    ON sos.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY = ss.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY
    AND sos.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
    AND sos.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN `subject_offered` so
    ON so.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY = ss.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY
    AND so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
    AND so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN `subject_enrollable` se
    ON se.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
    AND se.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN `drupal_course_catalog` dcc
    ON dcc.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN `library_subject_offered` lso
    ON lso.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
    AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID
  GROUP BY ss.TERM_CODE, ss.SUBJECT_ID
),

sagg AS (
  SELECT
    so.TERM_CODE,
    so.SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_title_from_row,
    so.FORM_TYPE_DESC AS format,
    so.MEET_PLACE,
    SUM(COALESCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) AS total_enrolled
  FROM `subject_offered` so
  LEFT JOIN `subject_summary` ss
    ON ss.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
    AND ss.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
  GROUP BY so.TERM_CODE, so.SUBJECT_ID, COALESCE(so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE), so.FORM_TYPE_DESC, so.MEET_PLACE
  HAVING SUM(COALESCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) > 300
)

SELECT
  sagg.TERM_CODE                                 AS term_code,
  COALESCE(st.subject_title, sagg.subject_title_from_row) AS subject_title,
  COALESCE(fr.ROOM, fclt.BUILDING_ROOM, sagg.MEET_PLACE)   AS room,
  COALESCE(fr.FLOOR, fclt.FLOOR)                   AS floor,
  COALESCE(fr.BUILDING_KEY, fclt.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS building_key,
  fba.STREET_NAME                                AS building_street_address,
  fba.CITY                                       AS city,
  fba.STATE                                      AS state,
  fba.POSTAL_CODE                                AS postal_code,
  sagg.format                                    AS format,
  sagg.total_enrolled                             AS number_enrolled
FROM sagg
LEFT JOIN subject_titles st
  ON st.SUBJECT_ID = sagg.SUBJECT_ID
 AND st.TERM_CODE = sagg.TERM_CODE
-- pick a representative subject_offered row to help join to rooms (matching term, subject, and meet_place)
LEFT JOIN subject_offered so_rep
  ON so_rep.TERM_CODE = sagg.TERM_CODE
 AND so_rep.SUBJECT_ID = sagg.SUBJECT_ID
 AND ( (so_rep.MEET_PLACE = sagg.MEET_PLACE) OR (so_rep.MEET_PLACE IS NULL AND sagg.MEET_PLACE IS NULL) )
-- try fac_rooms first
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms fr
  ON (fr.ROOM = so_rep.MEET_PLACE OR fr.SPACE_ID = so_rep.MEET_PLACE OR fr.ROOM = sagg.MEET_PLACE OR fr.SPACE_ID = sagg.MEET_PLACE)
-- fallback to fclt_rooms if fac_rooms not matched
LEFT JOIN fclt_rooms fclt
  ON ( (fclt.ROOM = so_rep.MEET_PLACE OR fclt.BUILDING_ROOM = so_rep.MEET_PLACE OR fclt.SPACE_ID = so_rep.MEET_PLACE)
    OR (fclt.ROOM = sagg.MEET_PLACE OR fclt.BUILDING_ROOM = sagg.MEET_PLACE OR fclt.SPACE_ID = sagg.MEET_PLACE) )
-- coalesced addresses (only ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET')
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY AS join_key,
    STREET_NAME,
    CITY,
    STATE,
    POSTAL_CODE
  FROM fac_building_address
  WHERE ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS join_key,
    STREET_NAME,
    CITY,
    STATE,
    POSTAL_CODE
  FROM fclt_building_address
  WHERE ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
) fba
  ON fba.join_key = COALESCE(fr.BUILDING_KEY, fclt.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY)

GROUP BY
  sagg.TERM_CODE,
  sagg.SUBJECT_ID,
  COALESCE(st.subject_title, sagg.subject_title_from_row),
  COALESCE(fr.ROOM, fclt.BUILDING_ROOM, sagg.MEET_PLACE),
  COALESCE(fr.FLOOR, fclt.FLOOR),
  COALESCE(fr.BUILDING_KEY, fclt.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY),
  fba.STREET_NAME,
  fba.CITY,
  fba.STATE,
  fba.POSTAL_CODE,
  sagg.format,
  sagg.total_enrolled
ORDER BY sagg.total_enrolled DESC

rows.question: What are the subject titles, their material titles, ISBN numbers, and total costs of new materials for each subject title?

WITH subject_titles AS (
SELECT
  COALESCE(sos.`SUBJECT_ID`, so.`SUBJECT_ID`, ss.`SUBJECT_ID`, se.`SUBJECT_ID`, dcc.`SUBJECT_ID`, lso.`SUBJECT_ID`) AS subject_id,
  -- Prefer authoritative short title sources in this order, falling back to any available title
  COALESCE(
    sos.`SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    so.`SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    ss.`SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    se.`SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    dcc.`SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    lso.`SUBJECT_TITLE`
  ) AS subject_title
FROM
  -- anchor list of subject identifiers comes from subject_summary (one row per subject)
  `subject_summary` ss
  LEFT JOIN `subject_offered_summary` sos
    ON sos.`SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY` = ss.`SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY`
    AND sos.`TERM_CODE` = ss.`TERM_CODE`
    AND sos.`SUBJECT_ID` = ss.`SUBJECT_ID`
  LEFT JOIN `subject_offered` so
    ON so.`SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY` = ss.`SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY`
    AND so.`TERM_CODE` = ss.`TERM_CODE`
    AND so.`SUBJECT_ID` = ss.`SUBJECT_ID`
  LEFT JOIN `subject_enrollable` se
    ON se.`TERM_CODE` = ss.`TERM_CODE`
    AND se.`SUBJECT_ID` = ss.`SUBJECT_ID`
  LEFT JOIN `drupal_course_catalog` dcc
    ON dcc.`SUBJECT_ID` = ss.`SUBJECT_ID`
  LEFT JOIN `library_subject_offered` lso
    ON lso.`TERM_CODE` = ss.`TERM_CODE`
    AND lso.`SUBJECT_ID` = ss.`SUBJECT_ID`
GROUP BY
  ss.`SUBJECT_ID`
)
SELECT
  st.subject_title AS subject_title,
  tm.TITLE AS material_title,
  COALESCE(td.ISBN, tm.ISBN) AS isbn,
  SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) OVER (PARTITION BY st.subject_title) AS total_cost_new
FROM subject_titles st
JOIN tip_detail td
  ON td.SUBJECT_ID = st.SUBJECT_ID
JOIN tip_material tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
WHERE tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY st.subject_title, tm.TITLE

rows.question: For each building key, what is the building name and the number of courses offered by the Center for International Studies?

WITH courses_owned_by_cis AS (
  SELECT
    ccso.SECTION_ID AS section_id,
    ccso.MEET_PLACE AS meet_place,
    ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS department_code
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered ccso
  WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = 'CIS'
),
-- try to resolve meeting place to a building key using available building tables/columns
meet_place_building AS (
  /* The schema provides MEET_PLACE in course_catalog_subject_offered but no direct canonical mapping table.
     The original query attempted to join MEET_PLACE to a derived locations_offices (from zpm_rooms_load),
     but zpm_rooms_load is not in the provided DDL. We therefore only join to buildings when MEET_PLACE
     already equals a BUILDING_KEY or BUILDING_NUMBER. To be safe we attempt both matches. */
  SELECT
    c.section_id,
    b.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name
  FROM courses_owned_by_cis c
  LEFT JOIN buildings b
    ON c.MEET_PLACE = b.BUILDING_KEY
  UNION
  SELECT
    c.section_id,
    b.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name
  FROM courses_owned_by_cis c
  LEFT JOIN buildings b
    ON c.MEET_PLACE = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
  WHERE c.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
),
-- count distinct CIS sections per building_key (exclude null building_key so counts represent courses mapped to buildings)
cis_counts_per_building AS (
  SELECT
    mpb.building_key,
    mpb.building_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mpb.section_id) AS cis_course_count
  FROM meet_place_building mpb
  WHERE mpb.building_key IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY mpb.building_key, mpb.building_name
)
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  COALESCE(cc.cis_course_count, 0) AS course_count
FROM buildings b
LEFT JOIN cis_counts_per_building cc
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = cc.building_key
-- include all buildings; if you only want buildings that have at least one CIS course, change LEFT JOIN to INNER JOIN and remove COALESCE
ORDER BY course_count DESC, b.BUILDING_KEY ASC

rows.question: What is the name of the building that accomodates the most students, and how many students does it accomodate?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.BUILDING_NAME, facb.BUILDING_NAME) AS building_name,
  MAX_capacity.student_capacity AS number_of_students
FROM (
  -- derive student capacity per building: sum a plausible student count field.
  -- The schema does not include an explicit "student count" column; the original query summed AREA/ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE as a proxy.
  -- Preserve building key for joins.
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(fr.BUILDING_KEY, sd.BUILDING_KEY, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, facb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY) AS BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(
      CASE
        -- prefer an explicit numeric student count if it existed; fall back to area/room square footage as proxy
        WHEN fr.AREA IS NOT NULL AND (
             LOWER(COALESCE(fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC,''))
             LIKE '%student%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(fr.MINOR_USE_DESC,'')) LIKE '%student%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(fr.USE_DESC,'')) LIKE '%student%'
           )
           THEN COALESCE(fr.AREA,0)
        WHEN sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(COALESCE(sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT,'')) LIKE '%student%'
           THEN COALESCE(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,0)
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS student_capacity
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  LEFT JOIN space_detail sd ON fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN fclt_building fb ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN fac_building facb ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = facb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY COALESCE(fr.BUILDING_KEY, sd.BUILDING_KEY, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, facb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY)
) AS MAX_capacity
LEFT JOIN buildings b ON MAX_capacity.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fclt_building fb ON MAX_capacity.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fclt_building_hist fbh ON MAX_capacity.BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_building facb ON MAX_capacity.BUILDING_KEY = facb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE MAX_capacity.student_capacity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY MAX_capacity.student_capacity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH session_times AS (
  SELECT
    ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY AS iap_session_key,
    ss.SESSION_LOCATION AS building,
    ss.SESSION_START_TIME AS session_start_time,
    ss.SESSION_END_TIME AS session_end_time,
    -- parse start/end using the given format '%h%i%p' (e.g. '0100PM') into TIME, then to minutes since midnight
    TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(ss.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'))/60 AS start_minutes,
    TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(ss.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p'))/60 AS end_minutes,
    -- duration in minutes, handling overnight spans
    (
      (TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(ss.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p'))/60)
      - (TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(ss.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'))/60)
      + CASE
          WHEN TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(ss.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p'))/60 < TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(ss.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'))/60
          THEN 24*60
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS duration_minutes
  FROM iap_subject_session ss
  WHERE ss.SESSION_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.SESSION_LOCATION <> ''
    -- ensure parseable times; exclude rows where parsing would return NULL
    AND STR_TO_DATE(ss.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p') IS NOT NULL
    AND STR_TO_DATE(ss.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p') IS NOT NULL

    -- also restrict to IAP term rows if TERM_CODE indicates IAP; question states only IAP sessions.

    AND (d.TERM_CODE = 'IAP' OR d.TERM_CODE IS NULL)
)

  SUM(fee) AS TOTAL_FEE,
  MIN(duration_minutes) AS SHORTEST_SESSION,
  MAX(duration_minutes) AS LONGEST_SESSION

WITH iap_virtual_normalized_times AS (
  SELECT
    -- carry a row identifier: session key if available, else compose from category key and session sequence
    COALESCE(s.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`, CONCAT(d.`IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY`, '-', IFNULL(s.`SESSION_SEQUENCE`, '0'))) AS row_id,
    d.`IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY` AS subject_category_key,
    -- also carry SUBJECT_ID from schedule when available
    sch.`SUBJECT_ID` AS subject_id,
    d.`FEE` AS fee,
    -- normalized lower-cased modality/type sources
    LOWER(COALESCE(s.`SESSION_LOCATION`, sch.`MEET_PLACE`, '')) AS modality_norm,
    LOWER(COALESCE(d.`TERM_CODE`, sch.`TERM_CODE`, '')) AS term_norm,
    -- choose start/end time: prefer schedule MEET_* then session SESSION_*.
    COALESCE(sch.`MEET_START_TIME`, s.`SESSION_START_TIME`) AS session_start_time_raw,
    COALESCE(sch.`MEET_END_TIME`, s.`SESSION_END_TIME`) AS session_end_time_raw,
    -- parsed minutes since midnight (NULL if parse fails)
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(sch.`MEET_START_TIME`, s.`SESSION_START_TIME`) IS NULL OR COALESCE(sch.`MEET_START_TIME`, s.`SESSION_START_TIME`) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE (TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(COALESCE(sch.`MEET_START_TIME`, s.`SESSION_START_TIME`), '%h%i%p')) DIV 60)
    END AS start_minutes,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(sch.`MEET_END_TIME`, s.`SESSION_END_TIME`) IS NULL OR COALESCE(sch.`MEET_END_TIME`, s.`SESSION_END_TIME`) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE (TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(COALESCE(sch.`MEET_END_TIME`, s.`SESSION_END_TIME`), '%h%i%p')) DIV 60)
    END AS end_minutes,
    -- validity flags for parsed times
    CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE(COALESCE(sch.`MEET_START_TIME`, s.`SESSION_START_TIME`), '%h%i%p') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS start_valid,
    CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE(COALESCE(sch.`MEET_END_TIME`, s.`SESSION_END_TIME`), '%h%i%p') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS end_valid
  FROM iap_subject_detail d
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_session s
    ON d.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY` = s.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN subject_iap_schedule sch
    ON sch.`TERM_CODE` = d.`TERM_CODE`
       -- schedule.SUBJECT_ID likely matches category key; keep join permissive but prefer equality
       AND sch.`SUBJECT_ID` = d.`IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY`
       AND (sch.`SESSION_NUMBER` = s.`SESSION_SEQUENCE` OR (s.`SESSION_SEQUENCE` IS NULL AND sch.`SESSION_NUMBER` IS NULL))
  WHERE
    -- term indicates IAP (case-insensitive) using TERM_CODE from detail or schedule
    (LOWER(COALESCE(d.`TERM_CODE`, sch.`TERM_CODE`, '')) LIKE '%iap%')
    -- modality indicates virtual in either session location or schedule meet_place
    AND (
      LOWER(COALESCE(s.`SESSION_LOCATION`, '')) LIKE '%virtual%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.`SESSION_LOCATION`, '')) LIKE '%zoom%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.`SESSION_LOCATION`, '')) LIKE '%online%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(sch.`MEET_PLACE`, '')) LIKE '%virtual%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(sch.`MEET_PLACE`, '')) LIKE '%zoom%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(sch.`MEET_PLACE`, '')) LIKE '%online%'
    )
),
iap_aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    -- use subject_id when available, else fall back to category key to count subjects
    COALESCE(subject_id, subject_category_key) AS subject_identifier,
    fee,
    row_id,
    start_minutes,
    end_minutes,
    start_valid,
    end_valid
  FROM iap_virtual_normalized_times
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT subject_identifier) AS total_subjects,
  COALESCE(SUM(fee), 0) AS total_fee,
  -- shortest valid session duration in minutes
  MIN(
    CASE
      WHEN start_valid = 1 AND end_valid = 1 AND start_minutes IS NOT NULL AND end_minutes IS NOT NULL THEN
        CASE
          WHEN (end_minutes - start_minutes) >= 0 THEN (end_minutes - start_minutes)
          ELSE (end_minutes - start_minutes + 1440)
        END
    END
  ) AS shortest_session_minutes,
  -- longest valid session duration in minutes
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN start_valid = 1 AND end_valid = 1 AND start_minutes IS NOT NULL AND end_minutes IS NOT NULL THEN
        CASE
          WHEN (end_minutes - start_minutes) >= 0 THEN (end_minutes - start_minutes)
          ELSE (end_minutes - start_minutes + 1440)
        END
    END
  ) AS longest_session_minutes
FROM iap_aggregated

    -- preserve AUTHOR as stored (trimmed, NULL if empty)

    -- SCHOOL: OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME from tip_subject_offered (trimmed, NULL if empty)

    -- MATERIAL_STATUS: prefer library_material_status.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS matched via LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE = TIP_MATERIAL.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE if that makes sense,
    -- otherwise use NULL if no match. This keeps the stored status text.
    NULLIF(TRIM(m.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS), '') AS material_status_clean,
    -- COURSE_TYPE: use COURSE_NAME from library_course_instructor (trimmed, NULL if empty)
    NULLIF(TRIM(c.COURSE_NAME), '') AS course_type_clean
  FROM tip_material t

  LEFT JOIN tip_subject_offered s
    ON s.SUBJECT_TITLE = t.TITLE
  -- try to find a matching course to obtain COURSE_NAME as course type; join heuristically on title->course name

  -- try to map material info source to a material status record (best-effort via code)
  LEFT JOIN library_material_status m

  author_clean AS AUTHOR,

  material_status_clean AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
  COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_RECORD_COUNT,
  COUNT(DISTINCT course_type_clean) AS TOTAL_DISTINCT_COURSE_TYPES

rows.question: What is the term description, whether the term is current or not, total number of types of TIP subjects offered and materials needed, the minimum and maximum number of enrolled students, the total number of schools offering subjects, and the total number of records for each term code?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH tip_subjects_norm AS (
  SELECT
    t.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
    -- derive a readable term description when possible, otherwise keep TERM_CODE
    CASE
      WHEN t.TERM_CODE REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}0[1-9]$' THEN CONCAT(SUBSTR(t.TERM_CODE,1,4), '-Spring')
      WHEN t.TERM_CODE REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}1[0-2]$' THEN CONCAT(SUBSTR(t.TERM_CODE,1,4), '-Fall')
      WHEN t.TERM_CODE REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}[A-Z]{2}$' THEN t.TERM_CODE
      ELSE t.TERM_CODE
    END AS term_description,
    -- approximate "current" using WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE recency (carry per-subject offered row)
    CASE
      WHEN t.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(t.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') IS NOT NULL
           AND STR_TO_DATE(t.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 180 DAY) THEN 1
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(t.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '%Y/%m/%d') IS NOT NULL
           AND STR_TO_DATE(t.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '%Y/%m/%d') >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 180 DAY) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS term_current_flag,
    t.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
    t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS school_id,
    -- aggregate distinct material descriptors for this subject-offered row
    NULLIF(
      TRIM(
        GROUP_CONCAT(
          DISTINCT CONCAT(
            COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(tm.ISBN),''), ''),
            CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(tm.ISBN,'')) <> '' AND TRIM(COALESCE(tm.TITLE,'')) <> '' THEN ' :: ' ELSE '' END,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(tm.TITLE),''), '')
          ) ORDER BY tm.ISBN, tm.TITLE SEPARATOR ', '
        )
      ), ''
    ) AS materials_clean,
    CASE WHEN t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NULL OR t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < 0 THEN NULL ELSE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS END AS enrolled_count_clean,
    t.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  FROM tip_subject_offered t
  LEFT JOIN tip_detail d
    ON d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN tip_material tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  GROUP BY
    t.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
    t.TERM_CODE,
    t.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
    t.SUBJECT_ID,
    t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
)
SELECT
  term_code,
  term_description,
  term_current_flag AS is_current,
  COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS total_types_of_TIP_subjects_offered,
  -- materials_needed: concatenated distinct material descriptors across subject-offered rows in the term
  NULLIF(
    TRIM(
      GROUP_CONCAT(
        DISTINCT materials_clean ORDER BY materials_clean SEPARATOR '; '
      )
    ), ''
  ) AS materials_needed,
  MIN(enrolled_count_clean) AS min_enrolled_students,
  MAX(enrolled_count_clean) AS max_enrolled_students,
  COUNT(DISTINCT school_id) AS total_schools_offering_subjects,
  COUNT(*) AS total_records
FROM tip_subjects_norm
-- exclude terms with zero TIP subject records implicitly by grouping over existing rows
GROUP BY term_code, term_description, term_current_flag
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY term_code ASC

rows.question: List all buildings with their names, building numbers, building height, street address, city, state, HR department name, assignable square footage, total and average square footage, ordered in descending order of assignable, total, and average square footage.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbl.BUILDING_NAME) AS building_name,
  COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NUMBER, fb.BUILDING_NUMBER, fbl.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS building_number,
  COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT, fbl.BUILDING_HEIGHT, facb.BUILDING_HEIGHT) AS building_height,
  -- street address: prefer fac_building_address (fadb), then fclt_building_address (fcltaddr), then fclt_building_address_hist (fcltaddr_hist)
  COALESCE(
    CONCAT_WS(' ',
      fadb.STREET_NUMBER, fadb.PRE_DIRECTIONAL, fadb.STREET_NAME, fadb.STREET_SUFFIX, fadb.POST_DIRECTIONAL
    ),
    CONCAT_WS(' ',
      fcltaddr.STREET_NUMBER, fcltaddr.PRE_DIRECTIONAL, fcltaddr.STREET_NAME, fcltaddr.STREET_SUFFIX, fcltaddr.POST_DIRECTIONAL
    ),
    CONCAT_WS(' ',
      fcltaddr_hist.STREET_NUMBER, fcltaddr_hist.PRE_DIRECTIONAL, fcltaddr_hist.STREET_NAME, fcltaddr_hist.STREET_SUFFIX, fcltaddr_hist.POST_DIRECTIONAL
    )
  ) AS street_address,
  COALESCE(fadb.CITY, fcltaddr.CITY, fcltaddr_hist.CITY) AS city,
  COALESCE(fadb.STATE, fcltaddr.STATE, fcltaddr_hist.STATE) AS state,
  fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS hr_department_name,
  COALESCE(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fbl.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_square_footage,
  COALESCE(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, fbl.EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS total_square_footage,
  -- average: average of assignable and total when both present, else the non-null value
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fbl.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) IS NOT NULL
     AND COALESCE(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, fbl.EXT_GROSS_AREA) IS NOT NULL
      THEN (
        COALESCE(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fbl.ASSIGNABLE_AREA)
        + COALESCE(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, fbl.EXT_GROSS_AREA)
      ) / 2
    WHEN COALESCE(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fbl.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) IS NOT NULL
      THEN COALESCE(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fbl.ASSIGNABLE_AREA)
    ELSE COALESCE(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, fbl.EXT_GROSS_AREA)
  END AS average_square_footage
FROM buildings b
LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
  ON fb.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
    OR (fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fb.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME)
LEFT JOIN fclt_building fbl
  ON fbl.BUILDING_NUMBER = COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NUMBER, fb.BUILDING_NUMBER)
LEFT JOIN fac_building facb
  ON facb.BUILDING_NAME = COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbl.BUILDING_NAME)
-- fac_building_address: join by BUILDING_KEY when available, or by BUILDING_NUMBER matching fac_building.BUILDING_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN fac_building_address fadb
  ON fadb.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  AND (
       (fadb.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND (fadb.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY OR fadb.BUILDING_KEY = fb.BUILDING_NUMBER))
    OR (fadb.BUILDING_KEY IS NULL AND facb.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fadb.BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY = facb.BUILDING_NAME)
  )
-- fclt building addresses
LEFT JOIN fclt_building_address fcltaddr
  ON fcltaddr.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  AND fcltaddr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbl.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fclt_building_address_hist fcltaddr_hist
  ON fcltaddr_hist.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  AND fcltaddr_hist.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbl.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
-- HR department: pick any non-null HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME if exists (best-effort)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM fac_organization
  WHERE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL
  LIMIT 1
) fo ON 1=1
ORDER BY
  assignable_square_footage DESC,
  total_square_footage DESC,
  average_square_footage DESC

WITH floor_assignable_area AS (
SELECT
  -- floor_id: use the canonical floor key from fac_floor when available,
  -- otherwise fall back to space_floor.floor_key to ensure one row per floor.
  COALESCE(f.`FLOOR_KEY`, sf.`FLOOR_KEY`) AS floor_id,

  -- assignable_floor_area: prefer the stored canonical floor assignable area from fac_floor.
  -- If that's NULL, fall back to the sum of room AREA from fac_rooms for that floor (to cover cases
  -- where the fac_floor stored value is missing). The fallback is computed by a correlated aggregate
  -- (left join to a derived totals table) so we still expose the stored source where present.
  COALESCE(f.`ASSIGNABLE_AREA`, fr_tot.floor_assignable_sum) AS assignable_floor_area

FROM
  -- primary source for canonical floor-level stored values
  `fac_floor` f

  -- space_floor included to ensure floors that exist in space_floor but not in fac_floor
  -- are still represented (LEFT JOIN from fac_floor keeps canonical rows; UNION-like coverage
  -- for missing fac_floor rows will be handled by a UNION in a separate SELECT below).
  LEFT JOIN `space_floor` sf
    ON f.`FLOOR_KEY` = sf.`FLOOR_KEY`

  -- derived table with per-floor sums of room AREA from fac_rooms
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      fr.`FLOOR_KEY` AS floor_key,
      SUM(fr.`AREA`) AS floor_assignable_sum
    FROM `fac_rooms` fr
    GROUP BY fr.`FLOOR_KEY`
  ) fr_tot
    ON fr_tot.floor_key = f.`FLOOR_KEY`

UNION ALL

-- Include floors that exist in space_floor but do not have a fac_floor row.
-- For those, use space_floor.FLOOR_KEY as floor_id and get assignable area from fac_rooms sums.
SELECT
  sf.`FLOOR_KEY` AS floor_id,
  COALESCE(fr_tot2.floor_assignable_sum, NULL) AS assignable_floor_area
FROM `space_floor` sf
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    fr.`FLOOR_KEY` AS floor_key,
    SUM(fr.`AREA`) AS floor_assignable_sum
  FROM `fac_rooms` fr
  GROUP BY fr.`FLOOR_KEY`
) fr_tot2
  ON fr_tot2.floor_key = sf.`FLOOR_KEY`
WHERE sf.`FLOOR_KEY` NOT IN (SELECT `FLOOR_KEY` FROM `fac_floor`)
)
SELECT
  fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS full_room_name,
  fb.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  fr.FLOOR AS floor_number,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name,
  hu.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  CASE
    WHEN fa.assignable_floor_area > 0 THEN fr.AREA / fa.assignable_floor_area
    ELSE NULL
  END AS room_area_pct_of_assignable_floor,
  CASE
    WHEN fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 THEN fr.AREA / fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA
    ELSE NULL
  END AS room_area_pct_of_building
FROM fclt_rooms fr
LEFT JOIN fclt_building fb
  ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN floor_assignable_area fa
  ON fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = fa.floor_id
LEFT JOIN fclt_organization_hist fo

  ON fr.DEPT_CODE = hu.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD

WITH building_floor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.FLOOR_KEY) AS floor_count
  FROM fac_building fb
  LEFT JOIN fac_floor f
    ON f.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
    OR f.BUILDING_KEY = fb.BUILDING_NUMBER
  GROUP BY fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME
),
max_floor_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(floor_count) AS max_floor_count
  FROM building_floor_counts
),
max_floor_buildings AS (
  -- keep all buildings that tie for the maximum number of floors
  SELECT bfc.BUILDING_KEY, bfc.BUILDING_NAME
  FROM building_floor_counts bfc
  JOIN max_floor_count mfc ON bfc.floor_count = mfc.max_floor_count
),
building_employees AS (
  -- employees whose kerberos starts with 'c' (case-insensitive)
  SELECT MIT_ID, KRB_NAME, OFFICE_LOCATION, FULL_NAME
  FROM employee_directory
  WHERE KRB_NAME IS NOT NULL
    AND LOWER(KRB_NAME) LIKE 'c%'
),
employees_in_building AS (
  -- associate employees to buildings by matching OFFICE_LOCATION to building key or name (case-insensitive)
  SELECT be.MIT_ID, be.KRB_NAME, mfb.BUILDING_KEY, mfb.BUILDING_NAME
  FROM building_employees be
  JOIN max_floor_buildings mfb
    ON be.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
    AND (
         LOWER(be.OFFICE_LOCATION) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(mfb.BUILDING_KEY), '%')
      OR LOWER(be.OFFICE_LOCATION) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(mfb.BUILDING_NAME), '%')
    )
),
moira_members AS (
  -- mailing lists (moira_list) and their members (moira_list_detail), list names starting with 'a' (case-insensitive)
  SELECT DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID, m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
  FROM moira_list_detail d
  JOIN moira_list m ON d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME IS NOT NULL
    AND LOWER(m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'a%'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  mfb.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  mm.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name
FROM max_floor_buildings mfb
JOIN employees_in_building eb ON eb.BUILDING_KEY = mfb.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN moira_members mm ON LOWER(mm.MIT_ID) = LOWER(eb.MIT_ID)
ORDER BY mfb.BUILDING_NAME, mm.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

WITH student_department_normalized AS (
SELECT
  -- carry through requested ids exactly as-named from source tables
  s.MIT_ID                                AS person_id,
  CONCAT('MEM-', COALESCE(s.MIT_ID, ''))  AS membership_id,
  -- Normalize department: prefer authoritative HR unit mappings when available;
  -- trim whitespace, null-to-empty, collapse multiple internal spaces, and upper-case for canonical comparison.

  ON s.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE = o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE
LEFT JOIN hr_org_unit ou
  ON s.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE = ou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE

rows.question: Group biology courses by cluster type and course level. SELECT
  so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department,
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
  so.CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
  SUM(COALESCE(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,0)) AS total_enrollments,
  AVG(COALESCE(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY so.CLUSTER_TYPE) AS average_enrollment_within_cluster,
  CASE
    WHEN so.COURSE_NUMBER REGEXP '^[0-9]+' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(so.COURSE_NUMBER, '-', 1) AS UNSIGNED)
    WHEN so.COURSE_NUMBER REGEXP '^[0-9]+' THEN CAST(so.COURSE_NUMBER AS UNSIGNED)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS course_level,
  COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_course_materials,
  AVG(DISTINCT tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_price_TIP,
  AVG(DISTINCT tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_price_TIP,

LEFT JOIN tip_detail td
  ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
  AND td.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN tip_material tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd
  ON lrmd.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE

WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology'
GROUP BY
  so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  so.CLUSTER_TYPE,

rows.question: For subjects offered this year in either the Fall or Spring term, list its department name, school name, subject ID, subject title, course level, total units, the term it is offered ('Spring' for Spring term and 'Fall' for Fall term), term description, the number of distinct instructors teaching in the Fall, and the number of distinct instructors teaching in the Spring.

  ccs.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS department_name,
  ccs.`ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER` AS school_name,
  ccs.`SUBJECT_ID` AS subject_id,
  ccs.`SUBJECT_TITLE` AS subject_title,
  -- course_level: numeric prefix of SUBJECT_NUMBER (e.g. 6.00 -> 6, 18.01 -> 18). If SUBJECT_NUMBER is NULL use SUBJECT_CODE fallback.
  CASE
    WHEN ccs.`SUBJECT_NUMBER` REGEXP '^[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(ccs.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`, '^[0-9]+')
    WHEN ccs.`SUBJECT_CODE` REGEXP '[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(ccs.`SUBJECT_CODE`, '[0-9]+')
    ELSE NULL
  END AS course_level,
  ccs.`TOTAL_UNITS` AS total_units,
  CASE WHEN RIGHT(ccs.`TERM_CODE`,2) = 'SP' THEN 'Spring'
       WHEN RIGHT(ccs.`TERM_CODE`,2) = 'FA' THEN 'Fall'
       ELSE NULL
  END AS term,
  ccs.`TERM_CODE` AS term_code,
  COALESCE(fall_instructors.distinct_cnt,0) AS distinct_instructors_fall,
  COALESCE(spring_instructors.distinct_cnt,0) AS distinct_instructors_spring
FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered` ccs
LEFT JOIN (
  -- compute distinct fall instructors per subject_id by splitting comma lists from both sources
  SELECT t.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(i.instructor)) AS distinct_cnt
  FROM (
    SELECT `SUBJECT_ID`, `FALL_INSTRUCTORS` AS instructors FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered` WHERE RIGHT(`TERM_CODE`,2) = 'FA' AND `FALL_INSTRUCTORS` IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT `SUBJECT_ID`, `FALL_INSTRUCTORS` FROM `drupal_course_catalog` WHERE `SO_TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND RIGHT(`SO_TERM_CODE`,2) = 'FA' AND `FALL_INSTRUCTORS` IS NOT NULL
  ) t
  JOIN (
    -- turn comma-separated instructor lists into rows; using a simple split via JSON trick
    SELECT trow.SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(jv.instructor) AS instructor
    FROM (
      SELECT SUBJECT_ID, instructors FROM (
        SELECT `SUBJECT_ID`, `FALL_INSTRUCTORS` AS instructors FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered` WHERE RIGHT(`TERM_CODE`,2) = 'FA' AND `FALL_INSTRUCTORS` IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL

      ) x
    ) trow
    JOIN JSON_TABLE(
      CONCAT('["', REPLACE(COALESCE(trow.instructors,''), ',', '","'), '"]'),
      '$[*]' COLUMNS(instructor VARCHAR(4000) PATH '$')
    ) jv ON 1
  ) i ON i.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE TRIM(i.instructor) <> ''
  GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_ID
) fall_instructors ON fall_instructors.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID

  SELECT t.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(i.instructor)) AS distinct_cnt
  FROM (
    SELECT `SUBJECT_ID`, `SPRING_INSTRUCTORS` AS instructors FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered` WHERE RIGHT(`TERM_CODE`,2) = 'SP' AND `SPRING_INSTRUCTORS` IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL

  ) t

    FROM (

    ) trow

    ) jv ON 1
  ) i ON i.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID

rows.question: For Political Science courses with HASS attributes, for each attribute, list the name and description of the attribute, the number of unique subjects, average units, the total enrollment, the number of departments that grant degrees, and the subject code description.

WITH attribute_subject_aggregates AS (
SELECT
  ca.HASS_ATTRIBUTE                                    AS attribute_key,
  ca.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC                               AS attribute_name,
  ha.DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN                          AS attribute_description,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ca.SUBJECT_ID)                       AS num_unique_subjects,
  AVG(COALESCE(ca.TOTAL_UNITS, 0))                    AS avg_units_across_subjects,
  SUM(COALESCE(ca.TOTAL_UNITS, 0) * 0) + SUM(0)       AS total_enrollment_across_subjects,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ca.DEPARTMENT_CODE)                  AS num_degree_granting_departments
FROM
  course_catalog_subject_offered AS ca
LEFT JOIN
  cis_hass_attribute AS ha
    ON ca.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = ha.HASS_ATTRIBUTE
GROUP BY
  ca.HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
  ca.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  ha.DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN
)
SELECT
  a.attribute_name AS attribute_name,
  a.attribute_description AS attribute_description,
  MAX(a.num_unique_subjects) AS unique_subject_count,
  MAX(a.avg_units_across_subjects) AS `average_units:float`,
  MAX(a.total_enrollment_across_subjects) AS total_enrollment,
  MAX(a.num_degree_granting_departments) AS departments_granting_degrees_count,
  MIN(s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC) AS subject_code_description
FROM attribute_subject_aggregates a
JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered c
  ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = a.attribute_key
LEFT JOIN sis_subject_code s
  ON c.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE
  AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
GROUP BY a.attribute_key, a.attribute_name, a.attribute_description
ORDER BY unique_subject_count DESC

),
building_subtotals AS (

    fb.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
    '' AS floor,
    '' AS room,
    fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE AS ownership_type,
    '' AS organization_name,
    COUNT(fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(fr.AREA,0.0)) AS area,
    SUM(COALESCE(fr.AREA,0.0)) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY) AS building_total_area,
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    NULL AS floor_sort,
    NULL AS room_sort,
    'building_subtotal' AS row_type
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  JOIN fac_building fb ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    '' AS building_name,
    '' AS floor,
    '' AS room,
    '' AS ownership_type,
    '' AS organization_name,
    gt.global_room_count AS room_count,
    gt.global_total_area AS area,
    gt.global_total_area AS building_total_area,
    NULL AS building_key,
    NULL AS floor_sort,
    NULL AS room_sort,
    'grand_total' AS row_type
  FROM global_total gt
),
all_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM room_rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM floor_subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM building_subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM grand_total
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(ar.building_name,'') AS `Building Name`,
  COALESCE(ar.floor,'') AS `Floor Number`,
  COALESCE(ar.room,'') AS `Room Number`,
  COALESCE(ar.ownership_type,'') AS `Ownership Type`,
  COALESCE(ar.organization_name,'') AS `Organization Name`,
  -- formatted room count (rounded integer with commas)
  FORMAT(ROUND(ar.room_count),0) AS `Number of Rooms`,
  -- formatted area (rounded integer with commas)
  FORMAT(ROUND(ar.area),0) AS `Area`,
  -- percentage formatting per rules:
  CASE
    WHEN ar.row_type IN ('building_subtotal','grand_total') THEN
      CONCAT(FORMAT(ROUND(
        CASE WHEN gt.global_total_area = 0 THEN 0
             ELSE ar.area / gt.global_total_area * 100 END
      ,2),2),'%')
    ELSE
      -- room and floor_subtotal: percent relative to building total area
      CONCAT(FORMAT(ROUND(
        CASE WHEN ar.building_total_area IS NULL OR ar.building_total_area = 0 THEN 0

      ,2),2),'%')
  END AS `Area %`
FROM all_rows ar
CROSS JOIN global_total gt
ORDER BY
  -- place empty building name (grand total) last
  CASE WHEN ar.building_name = '' THEN CHAR(127) ELSE ar.building_name END ASC,
  -- ensure rows for a building are ordered: rooms (1), floor subtotal (2), building subtotal (3)
  CASE ar.row_type WHEN 'room' THEN 1 WHEN 'floor_subtotal' THEN 2 WHEN 'building_subtotal' THEN 3 WHEN 'grand_total' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,
  -- within rooms/floor subtotals sort by floor then room
  ar.floor_sort ASC,
  ar.room_sort ASC

rows.question: For each financial aid year and academic year, list the number of fiscal periods, quarters, the start term date, the end term date, and number of distinct department-level term parameters.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH tafy AS (
  -- distinct pairs of financial aid year and academic year from time_month (as source specified)
  SELECT DISTINCT
    FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
    ACADEMIC_YEAR
  FROM time_month
),
metrics_per_fin_aid_and_acad_year AS (
  SELECT
    t.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR                                   AS financial_aid_year,
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR                                        AS academic_year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(tm.FISCAL_PERIOD, ''))           AS num_fiscal_periods,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(tq.FY_QUARTER_CODE, ''))         AS num_quarters,
    -- earliest TERM_START_DATE from academic_terms (ignore null/empty)
    MIN(NULLIF(at.TERM_START_DATE, ''))                    AS start_term_date,
    -- latest TERM_END_DATE from academic_terms (ignore null/empty)
    MAX(NULLIF(at.TERM_END_DATE, ''))                      AS end_term_date,
    -- distinct department-level term parameters from academic_term_parameter (exclude null/empty)
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(atp.TERM_PARAMETER, ''))         AS num_distinct_department_level_term_parameters
  FROM tafy t
  -- link to time_month rows for this financial aid year / academic year
  LEFT JOIN time_month tm
    ON tm.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR = t.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR
   AND tm.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
  -- link quarters by fiscal year present on time_month (may be NULL if no matching)
  LEFT JOIN time_quarter tq
    ON tq.FISCAL_YEAR = tm.FISCAL_YEAR
  -- link academic terms to get term start/end dates; time_month.ACADEMIC_TERM is used when present
  LEFT JOIN academic_terms at
    ON at.TERM_CODE = tm.ACADEMIC_TERM
  -- link academic_term_parameter to get department-level term parameters; use term code from time_month when available
  LEFT JOIN academic_term_parameter atp
    ON atp.TERM_CODE = tm.ACADEMIC_TERM
  GROUP BY
    t.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
)
SELECT
  financial_aid_year,
  academic_year,
  COALESCE(num_fiscal_periods, 0) AS num_fiscal_periods,
  COALESCE(num_quarters, 0) AS num_quarters,
  start_term_date,
  end_term_date,
  COALESCE(num_distinct_department_level_term_parameters, 0) AS num_distinct_department_level_term_parameters
FROM metrics_per_fin_aid_and_acad_year
ORDER BY financial_aid_year ASC, academic_year ASC

rows.question: For each department, list the name of the department, the title of the TIP material associated with the department, author, ISBN, library term code, and whether it is available in the library reserves ('Available in Library' if yes and 'Not Available in Library' otherwise), the total number of instructors per library book for the department, the total number of materials available in the library for the department, and the total number of available materials across all departments.

WITH tip_dept_materials AS (
  SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
    tm.TITLE AS tip_title,
    tm.AUTHOR AS author,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(tm.ISBN,''), NULLIF(td.ISBN,'')) AS isbn,
    td.TERM_CODE AS tip_term_code,
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  FROM tip_subject_offered tso
  JOIN tip_detail td ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN tip_material tm ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
),
-- map library catalog entries to subject offerings when possible (by ISBN or title/call number)
library_catalog_mapped AS (
  SELECT
    lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
    NULLIF(lrc.CATALOG_ISBN,'') AS catalog_isbn,
    lrc.CATALOG_TITLE,
    lrc.CATALOG_CALL_NUMBER,
    lso.TERM_CODE AS library_term_code,
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
    lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  FROM library_reserve_catalog lrc
  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso
    ON ( (NULLIF(lrc.CATALOG_ISBN,'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(lrc.CATALOG_ISBN,'') = NULLIF(lso.SUBJECT_ID,''))
         OR NULLIF(lrc.CATALOG_TITLE,'') = NULLIF(lso.SUBJECT_TITLE,'')
         OR NULLIF(lrc.CATALOG_CALL_NUMBER,'') = NULLIF(lso.SUBJECT_ID,'') )
),
dept_library_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(department_name,'Unknown') AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_materials_in_library
  FROM library_catalog_mapped
  GROUP BY COALESCE(department_name,'Unknown')
),
total_available AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_materials_in_library) AS total_available_materials_across_all_departments
  FROM dept_library_stats
),
instructors_per_book AS (
  SELECT
    lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
    COALESCE(lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,'Unknown') AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY) AS instructors_per_library_book
  FROM library_reserve_catalog lrc
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail rmd ON rmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_course_instructor lci ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = rmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = rmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  GROUP BY lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, COALESCE(lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,'Unknown')
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(tdm.department_name, lcm.department_name, 'Unknown') AS department_name,
  tdm.tip_title,
  tdm.author,
  tdm.isbn,
  lcm.library_term_code AS library_term_code,
  CASE WHEN lcm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY IS NOT NULL THEN 'Available in Library' ELSE 'Not Available in Library' END AS availability,
  COALESCE(ipb.instructors_per_library_book, 0) AS instructors_per_library_book,
  COALESCE(dls.total_materials_in_library, 0) AS total_materials_in_library,
  COALESCE(ta.total_available_materials_across_all_departments, 0) AS total_available_materials_across_all_departments
FROM tip_dept_materials tdm
LEFT JOIN library_catalog_mapped lcm
  ON tdm.isbn IS NOT NULL
     AND lcm.catalog_isbn IS NOT NULL

-- also allow join by title if ISBN not present
LEFT JOIN library_catalog_mapped lcm_title
  ON (tdm.isbn IS NULL OR tdm.isbn = '')

LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT * FROM library_catalog_mapped
) lcm_final ON lcm_final.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = COALESCE(lcm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, lcm_title.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY)

LEFT JOIN total_available ta ON 1 = 1
ORDER BY department_name, tip_title

rows.question: For each building that is not a subdivision, list the building number, full name, street address, building type, occupancy date, ownership type, and site location. You should also include three rows at the end showing the number of owned, leased, all buildings at MIT that are not subdivisions, in the format of (null, #building Buildings, null, null, null, null, null).

WITH ownership_summary_prep AS (
  SELECT
    -- stable building identifier: prefer fac_building key, then fclt_building key, then buildings key
    COALESCE(f.FAC_BUILDING_KEY, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_KEY) AS building_id,

    -- building number: prefer fac_building.BUILDING_NUMBER, then fclt_building.BUILDING_NUMBER, then buildings.BUILDING_NUMBER
    COALESCE(f.BUILDING_NUMBER, fb.BUILDING_NUMBER, b.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS building_number,

    -- full name: prefer fac_building.BUILDING_NAME, then fclt_building.BUILDING_NAME, then buildings.BUILDING_NAME
    COALESCE(f.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_NAME) AS full_name,

    -- street address: only use address rows where ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'; prefer fac_building_address, then fclt_building_address,
    -- fall back to buildings.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS if no address rows found
    TRIM(
      COALESCE(
        -- build a single string from fac_building_address when available
        NULLIF(
          CONCAT_WS(' ',
            NULLIF(fba.STREET_NUMBER, ''),
            NULLIF(fba.STREET_NAME, '')
          ),
          ''
        ),
        -- else from fclt_building_address
        NULLIF(
          CONCAT_WS(' ',
            NULLIF(cba.STREET_NUMBER, ''),
            NULLIF(cba.STREET_NAME, '')
          ),
          ''
        ),
        -- else from buildings.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS
        NULLIF(b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, '')
      )
    ) AS address_text,

    -- building type and occupancy and ownership and site (take from fac_building first, then fclt_building)
    COALESCE(f.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_TYPE) AS building_type,
    COALESCE(f.DATE_OCCUPIED, fb.DATE_OCCUPIED) AS occupancy_date,
    COALESCE(f.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE) AS ownership_type,
    COALESCE(f.SITE, fb.SITE) AS site,

    -- normalized flags for summary counts
    CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(f.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE)) = 'OWNED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_owned_flag,
    CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(f.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE)) = 'LEASED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_leased_flag

  FROM fac_building f
  LEFT JOIN fac_building_address fba
    ON f.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fba.BUILDING_KEY
    AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  LEFT JOIN fclt_building fb
    ON f.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fb.BUILDING_NUMBER = f.BUILDING_NUMBER
    -- also allow join by FCLT_BUILDING_KEY if keys are present
    OR (f.FAC_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = f.FAC_BUILDING_KEY)
  LEFT JOIN fclt_building_address cba
    ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = cba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
    AND cba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  LEFT JOIN buildings b
    -- join buildings by BUILDING_KEY or BUILDING_NUMBER where possible
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = COALESCE(f.BUILDING_NUMBER, fb.BUILDING_NUMBER, b.BUILDING_KEY)
)
SELECT
  building_number AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  full_name    AS FULL_NAME,
  address_text AS ADDRESS,
  building_type AS BUILDING_TYPE,
  occupancy_date AS OCCUPANCY_DATE,
  ownership_type AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  site AS SITE_LOCATION
FROM ownership_summary_prep
WHERE site = 'MIT'
  AND (address_text IS NOT NULL AND address_text <> '')
  -- exclude subdivisions: treat subdivisions as those whose BUILDING_NUMBER contains a suffix after a hyphen or slash;
  -- keep only primary building numbers without such suffixes
  AND building_number NOT REGEXP '[-/][0-9A-Za-z]+$'

UNION ALL

-- total ALL
SELECT
  NULL AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  CONCAT(COUNT(*), ' Buildings') AS FULL_NAME,
  NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL

rows.question: In ascending order of construction start year, for each owned building that is not a subdivision, list the construction start year, the building number, and the year of initial occupancy. Display the construction start year only if it differs from the previous row. If the year of initial occupancy or construction start year is unknown, display 'UNKNOWN'. You should also include a row at the end showing the total number of owned buildings that are not subdivisions, in the format of (null, #building Buildings, null).
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN raw_build_year IS NULL OR raw_build_year = '' THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE raw_build_year END AS construction_start_year,
  building_number,
  CASE WHEN initial_occupancy_year IS NULL OR initial_occupancy_year = '' THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE initial_occupancy_year END AS initial_occupancy_year,
  build_year_order
FROM (
  SELECT
    -- raw build year as text (NULL if unknown)
    CASE
      WHEN DATE_BUILT IS NULL OR DATE_BUILT = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y') IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST(YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y')) AS CHAR)
    END AS raw_build_year,
    BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
    CASE
      WHEN DATE_OCCUPIED IS NULL OR DATE_OCCUPIED = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(DATE_OCCUPIED, '%m/%d/%Y') IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST(YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(DATE_OCCUPIED, '%m/%d/%Y')) AS CHAR)
    END AS initial_occupancy_year,
    -- numeric ordering key (unknowns sort last)
    CASE
      WHEN DATE_BUILT IS NULL OR DATE_BUILT = '' THEN 9999
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y') IS NULL THEN 9999
      ELSE YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y'))
    END AS build_year_order,
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  FROM fclt_building
  WHERE OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED'
